title.rendered: Real Madrid kits 25 – 2026 For Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Real Madrid DLS kits for season 2025/2026 URL is available for you to Copy and Import into any Dream League Soccer game, can also be use to import new jersey in FTS Mods.

When been used in any DLS game, it makes players appearance look so unique with this kits, especially in new seasons that you wish to see your in game player look good like the ones in the real world.
